data.title: Gender Distribution of Vacancies in Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Vacancies, Gender, Male, Female, Distribution, Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: Total number of vacant job positions classified by gender preference, as reported by establishments in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi on an annual basis.

data.description: Distribution of vacancies by gender in Abu Dhabi.

aiRecommendation.title: Narrow the Gender Vacancy Gap to Strengthen Female Labour Participation
aiRecommendation.title_ar: تضييق فجوة الشواغر بين الجنسين لتعزيز مشاركة المرأة في سوق العمل
aiRecommendation.text: Male-targeted vacancies outnumber female-targeted ones by 25%, highlighting an opportunity to design more inclusive job roles and accelerate female workforce participation across sectors.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: تفوق الشواغر الموجهة للذكور نظيراتها الموجهة للإناث بنسبة 25%، مما يُبرز فرصة لتصميم أدوار وظيفية أكثر شمولاً وتسريع مشاركة المرأة في سوق العمل عبر مختلف القطاعات.
aiRecommendation.reason: The gap between male and female vacancies reflects structural imbalances in how roles are defined and advertised. Addressing this through gender-neutral job descriptions and targeted outreach can help improve overall labour market inclusivity in Abu Dhabi.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: تعكس الفجوة بين شواغر الذكور والإناث اختلالات هيكلية في كيفية تحديد الأدوار والإعلان عنها. يمكن أن تساعد معالجة هذا الأمر من خلال توصيفات وظيفية محايدة جنسياً والتواصل الموجّه في تحسين الشمولية الإجمالية لسوق العمل في أبوظبي.
